adaptive_delay.description: Automatically increase delays when receiving rate-limit responses (429)

content_prioritization.description: Extract main content first, skip ads/nav/sidebar

anti_bot_detection.description: Detect anti-bot pages and adapt request strategy

javascript_rendering.description: Render JavaScript when needed (requires headless browser). Currently disabled.

cookie_persistence.description: Maintain cookies across requests for session preservation

link_quality_scoring.description: Score links by relevance and prioritize high-value URLs

dynamic_ua_rotation.description: Rotate browser fingerprints every N requests

status_codes.429: Rate limited - enable adaptive_delay and increase concurrency delay
status_codes.403: Forbidden - try different fingerprint or proxy
status_codes.999: LinkedIn block - use residential proxy if available

memory.description: Track errors and adapt strategy. Durations in milliseconds.

_comment: Crawler intelligence enables adaptive, resilient crawling. All strategies can be toggled individually. Requires server.js to be restarted for changes to take effect.
